Why DFCU offers this

CU Travel is DFCU's travel benefits partner, offering discounted rates and travel rewards exclusively to credit union members nationwide. This benefit is included in your DFCU membership at no cost — no card required, no expiration.

Questions

A few things people ask.

Is there a catch?

No. This is a benefit of your DFCU membership, fully covered — no payment information required to activate.

Do I have to be a DFCU member to use this?

Yes, this benefit is exclusive to DFCU members.

Will this affect my DFCU account?

No — CU Travel is a separate account you create; it doesn't touch your banking.
